decisions.reason: The digital twin service builds directly on the firm's established geospatial and data integration knowledge, enabling it to interpret early results and improve the offer.
Although it is close to existing integration work, it is less GIS-specific, so the firm's absorptive capacity is lower and withdrawal probability remains somewhat higher than for core products.
The open GIS framework is central to the firm's established development tools and deeply embedded in its existing knowledge, giving very high absorptive capacity.
The identity and access service directly extends the firm's GeoIT integration expertise, so it can apply related knowledge to keep improving it.
The consulting workshop leverages the firm's established consulting and geodata knowledge, enabling it to interpret early results and keep the offer.
